summary: Centre County, PA tree tower built 1916 with its observation post 35 ft up; registered 2008; no longer standing, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Tree tower; observation post set 35 feet above the ground
facts.status_note: Register says it is no longer standing; no source we read describes the site today

events.note: Tree tower built in 1916; Forest Lookouts describes a tree observation post established 35 feet above the ground
Register says the tower was still used circa 1917
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: tree tower built in 1916 and still used circa 1917
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1916 and was still used circa 1917

evidence.supports: register has no map coordinates for the site
tree observation post established 35 feet above the ground, dated 1916
evidence.quote: 1916: A tree observation post established 35 feet above the ground.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources, both one line of substance (built 1916, still used circa 1917, no longer standing). No staffing, fire or access information in either source, so the story leaves those out. The brief gives coordinates 40.9836, -77.2729, but the FFLOS page says 'No coordinates are available'; we could not verify the brief's coordinates and did not change them. height_m is left null: the 35-foot figure from the Forest Lookouts page is for the observation post, not a verified tower height.
